content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 8

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 8:3 | "Sons-of-Light" | "Sons of Light" | "army of light" | Sectarian title | SOPHIA: "Sons of Light" — PNEUMA's "army of light" loses the communal self-designation |
| 2 | 8:3 | "crush the-spirit-of the-enemy" | "crush the spirit of the enemy" | "break the enemy's will" | Theological term | SOPHIA: "crush the spirit" — ruach carries theological weight in DSS; "will" is reductive |
| 3 | 8:4 | "horses-of the-battle" | "horses of battle" | "warhorses" | Compound | SOPHIA: "horses of battle" per LOGOS — "warhorses" is a single compound absent in the Hebrew |
| 4 | 8:4 | "sights-of-slaughter" | "sight of slaughter" | "sight of bloodshed" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "sight of slaughter" — "bloodshed" (PNEUMA) shifts the image from battlefield carnage to blood specifically |
| 5 | 8:5 | "strong-of-heart" | "stout of heart" | "fearless" | Idiom | SOPHIA: "stout of heart" per LOGOS — preserves the Hebrew idiom; "fearless" is too modern/flat |
| 6 | 8:6 | "lands-of the-wide-open-spaces" | "open lands" | "open grasslands" | Specificity | SOPHIA: "open lands" per LOGOS — EMET is overliteral; PNEUMA's "grasslands" adds specificity not in Hebrew |
| 7 | 8:8 | "mighty-men-of-war" | "mighty men of war" | "seasoned warriors" | Register | SOPHIA: "mighty men of war" — gibbore milchamah deserves its full biblical register; "seasoned" is too casual |
| 8 | 8:10 | "lance-of battle" | "battle lance" | "battle lance" | Word order | SOPHIA: "battle lance" per LOGOS/PNEUMA — English compound is more natural |
| 9 | 8:11 | "lest-they-trample-them" | "lest they trample them" | "to avoid trampling their own soldiers" | Explicitation | SOPHIA: "lest they trample them" — PNEUMA's "their own soldiers" is an explicitation not in the text |
| 10 | 8:13 | "until-they-are-consumed" | "until they are consumed" | "destroy them completely" | Register | SOPHIA: "until they are consumed" — PNEUMA's paraphrase loses the consuming/fire imagery of Hebrew kalah |
| 11 | 8:15 | "the slain shall-fall" | "the slain shall fall" | "the dead pile up" | Register | SOPHIA: "the slain shall fall" — "pile up" (PNEUMA) is graphic but absent from the Hebrew |
